acceptance_criteria.criterion: Workflow läuft bei jedem PR automatisch
Ein fehlgeschlagener Check blockiert den Merge
Cache wird sinnvoll genutzt, ohne Secrets zu cachen

review_findings.summary: No top-level `permissions: contents: read`; only secret-scan job restricts its token.
.gitleaks.toml allowlists all of .env.example by path, not just the known demo values — a real secret pasted there later would be silently ignored.
Only incremental commit ranges are scanned; no scheduled full-history scan.
`pnpm -r --if-present test` silently skips packages without a test script.
Actions pinned to mutable major tags, not commit SHAs.
Node 20 deprecation warnings in every CI job.

residual_risks: No required_pull_request_reviews on branch protection — a PR can be merged as soon as checks are green, Opus verdict is not itself a required status check.
Migration Check workflow is not in the required-checks list on main.
gitleaks SARIF is uploaded as an artifact but not fed into GitHub code scanning.
required_actions: None blocking. Recommended non-blocking follow-up chore: top-level permissions:contents:read, narrow .gitleaks.toml allowlist, add Migration Check to required status checks, pin actions to SHAs, scheduled full-history secret scan.
